title: Playbook TradingAgents verdicts — 2026-11-10
summary: TradingAgents (market analyst only, DeepSeek, one debate and one risk round) returned Hold on Eaton for 2026-11-10: at $359.30 the stock sits below the 10-EMA ($363.23), the Bollinger basis ($379.25) and a rising 200-SMA ($396.35), with a 50/200 death cross in place and the MACD histogram still widening negative — yet the 6.59M-share capitulation flush through the lower band and six consecutive lower highs make the setup binary rather than directional. The plan keeps existing size, vetoes both adding into the unconfirmed bounce and shorting a washed-out low into a rising 200-SMA, and pre-commits two trigger levels. That is partial agreement with the playbook's BUY LIST stance — hold what you own, add only on a volume-confirmed close above $363.23, reduce only below $327.02.

rows: Hold at $359.30 at current size — no add, no short. A daily close above the 10-EMA ($363.23) on volume clearly above the 3.55M bounce pace (ideally toward the 6.59M selloff print) arms a conditional scale-in of thirds at $363.23 / $379.25 / $396.35 with a hard stop below $327.02, sized down given ATR $19.73. A daily close below $327.02 invalidates the long; only then a modest tactical short with a stop back above $340. Time horizon 3–6 months, event-driven off those two levels.

sections.heading: How the agent reasoned
sections.body: The bull argued asymmetric risk at a washed-out level: the selloff was a genuine 6.59M-share capitulation flush that pierced the lower Bollinger Band and snapped back, the 200-SMA is still rising ($380.92 on 09-11 to $396.35 now) so the long-term trend has not broken, and a stop near the $327.02 structure is roughly 1.5x an already-expanded $19.73 ATR. The bear won the factual points: price at $359.30 is below the 10-EMA ($363.23), the Bollinger basis ($379.25) and the 200-SMA ($396.35); the 50/200 death cross is in place; the MACD histogram is still widening negative at -2.93 rather than compressing; the VWMA ($365.34) above price means the average recent buyer is underwater, i.e. overhead supply; and the 3.55M-share bounce against 6.59M/6.03M sell days is as consistent with buyer indifference as with exhaustion. The risk judge refused both unconditional calls: the evidence cannot support the bull's Buy or the bear's implied short, so it keeps size unchanged, rejects trimming at the lower band right after a six-million-share flush into a rising 200-SMA, and lets the two trigger levels commit price with volume confirmation rather than mechanical touches.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.body: Market analyst only — no news, fundamentals or social agents; DeepSeek chat models via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint; one debate round and one risk round, so this is a shallow pass by design. LLM output can misstate numbers: verify every price level against the chart before acting. The BUY LIST → Agree/Partial/Disagree mapping and the Underweight-means-reduce scale translation are ours, not the agent's.
